meta.name: workflow-orchestration-patterns
meta.description: Design durable workflows with Temporal for distributed systems. Covers workflow vs activity separation, saga patterns, state management, and determinism constraints. Use when building long-running processes, distributed transactions, or microservice orchestration.

copy.tagline: 设计可靠的长时工作流与分布式事务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发分布式系统,需要编排长时运行的业务流程。
copy.tagline_en: Design reliable long-running workflows and distributed transactions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building distributed systems and need to orchestrate long-running business processes.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会依据该技能给出Temporal工作流设计建议：区分工作流与活动分工、用Saga模式协调跨服务事务、注意确定性约束与状态自动保存，并设置超时和重试以支持失败恢复。
howto.when: 当构建长时间运行的流程、分布式事务或微服务编排时触发。

say.text: 帮我把一个下单流程拆成工作流和活动，用Temporal实现。
say.note: Claude会给出工作流与活动的职责划分建议。

say.text: 用Saga模式实现跨支付和库存的分布式事务，怎么设计？
say.note: Claude会解释Saga模式的补偿步骤。

say.text: 我写的工作流用了datetime.now()，会有什么问题？

howto.what_en: Guides using Temporal for durable workflows: separates workflows from activities, applies Saga for distributed transactions, enforces determinism, auto state persistence, and recommends timeouts/retries for recovery.
howto.when_en: Use when building long-running processes, distributed transactions, or microservice orchestration.

say_en.text: Help me decompose an order flow into workflows and activities using Temporal.
say_en.note: Claude explains how to separate orchestration from execution.

say_en.text: How to use Saga for cross-service distributed transactions?
My workflow uses datetime.now(). What problems will this cause?
say_en.note: Claude explains non-determinism and suggests workflow.now().
